settings.heading: Know what you're doing before you spend a penny.
settings.body: Three guides and a working calculator. Free, no signup, no upsell.

settings.label: GUIDE 01
settings.heading: Platform Guide
settings.body: Where to sell what, and why the same item performs completely differently on Vinted, eBay, TikTok Shop and Facebook Marketplace. Includes a category-by-category match for everything GBG stocks, and a six-step method for choosing a platform for a new pack.

settings.label: GUIDE 02
settings.heading: Pricing Calculator
settings.body: A working tool, not an article. Put in your pack cost, unit count, packaging and platform fee, and it gives you the lowest price you can list at without losing money. Know that number before you ever accept an offer.

settings.label: GUIDE 03
settings.heading: Listings Guide
settings.body: How to write a listing that gets found and then gets bought - titles built from real search words, phone photography that works, descriptions that answer questions before they're asked, and how to diagnose a failing listing from its own view count.

settings.label: GUIDE 04
settings.heading: Platform Safety Guide
settings.body: The listing patterns that get reseller accounts restricted, how to grow without tripping them, what to do in what order if you're already restricted, and how to avoid the scams that target sellers rather than buyers.

settings.heading: Buy your first pack
settings.body: You know what sells where and what to charge. Start with a Starter Box if you want the lowest-risk entry.

settings.heading: Ask the community
settings.body: SYPB is free and open. Ask the questions the guides didn't answer, before you spend anything.

settings.heading: Get guided properly
settings.body: If reading isn't enough and you want someone reviewing your actual listings and numbers, join the Academy.

settings.heading: Ask before you spend.
settings.body: If a guide doesn't fit your situation, message us and we'll tell you what we'd actually do.
